title: You Said You'd Binned It
gist_ar: مشهد فيلم بتعبيرات عامية: الخلاف على إنه قال إنه رمى كل حاجة.

before_listening.en: A scene full of idiom. Two people, one photograph. Listen for what she actually accuses him of.
before_listening.ar: مشهد مليان تعبيرات عامية. شخصين وصورة واحدة. ركّز على هي بتتهمه بإيه فعلًا.

segments.speaker: Mona
segments.text: You kept it. Don't — don't give me the face. You told me you'd binned the lot.

segments.speaker: Tarek
segments.text: I said I'd binned the letters. Which I did, and it nearly did me in, if we're keeping score.

segments.speaker: Mona
segments.text: Oh, we're keeping score now, are we. Because from where I'm sitting you've been sitting on this for eight months and letting me think otherwise.

segments.speaker: Tarek
segments.text: That's a bit rich. It's been in the drawer since we moved. I haven't been sitting on anything, it's been sitting there, which is not the same and you know it isn't.

segments.speaker: Mona
segments.text: Fine. Splitting hairs. Go on then.

segments.speaker: Tarek
segments.text: The letters were doing my head in. Every time I read them I came out worse. The photo's four of us on a beach. Nobody's kicking off in it. That's the whole point of it.

segments.speaker: Mona
segments.text: That is exactly what's wrong with it. Sorry. That came out — no, actually, I'll stand by that. I don't see a beach. I see the morning after, and you in the kitchen saying nothing while I'd been asking you all week.

segments.speaker: Mona
segments.text: Do you? Because 'I know' has been doing a lot of heavy lifting in this house.

segments.speaker: Tarek
segments.text: What do you want me to say? I fudged it. In the car, coming back, you were in bits and I took the short version because the long one was going to take an hour.

segments.speaker: Mona
segments.text: Right. So the short version was a lie you could live with.

segments.speaker: Tarek
segments.text: The short version was 'I've binned everything' and what I meant was 'I'm not going to be the bloke who keeps a shrine'. Those aren't the same and I knew it at the time.

segments.speaker: Mona
segments.text: Thank you. That's all I was after.

gist_question.q: What is she actually accusing him of?
options: Keeping a photograph he had no right to keep
Throwing away the letters without telling her
Saying something he knew was not what he meant, and letting it stand

questions.q: What does 'that's a bit rich' mean here?
options: That her accusation is unfair coming from her

questions.q: What does she mean by "'I know' has been doing a lot of heavy lifting"?
questions.q_ar: إيه معنى إن 'أنا عارف' شايلة حمل كبير؟
options: He uses it to end conversations instead of answering

questions.q: What does he admit at the end?
options: He knew at the time that what he said was not what he meant
He put the photograph in the drawer deliberately
